data.hypothesis: Replacing the two rsqrtf refinement cycles with a float32 square root and reciprocal may reduce per-interaction refinement work while avoiding accumulated reciprocal-square-root approximation error at large sizes. The speed and correctness effects remain unmeasured.
data.notes: Retains one thread per target, source traversal, float32 softening, self-pair skip, update order, and exact mass copying. The prior candidate passed the reported cases except for one mismatch at n=16384. The controller must validate numerical tolerances, nonfinite outputs, and the extreme-mass case before timing; no candidate measurement is available.
transformations: Replace rsqrtf and its two Newton refinements with 1.0f / sqrtf(distSq), then form inverse-distance-cubed using float32 multiplies.
Keep interaction traversal, accumulation, self-pair handling, and particle update sequence unchanged.
